text:
Elena Park: FYI I'm planning parental leave starting Dec 1 (~10 weeks). Two quick questions: 1) Is there a short-term sitter stipend (like for evenings) for the first month? 2) What's the minimum handoff for the on-call rotation and recurring customer check-ins?

people-ops-bot: Hi Elena! See: https://intranet.redwood/people/parental-benefits. The Backup Care subsidy covers vetted sitters/licensed care up to $1,200/mo for eligible employees. Please submit the parental intake form to initiate.

omar_s: @Elena we usually reimburse vetted sitter invoices as non-taxable reimbursements. Upload receipts to HR portal > Reimbursements > Backup Care. Retro requests accepted up to 60 days.

Katherine Wu: For on-call: minimum handoff = link to runbook pages + list of 3 likely alerts, escalation contacts, and current OOO duration in the schedule. I can cover weeks 1 and 5 if helpful.

Elena Park: Helpful. I'll add the runbook links and a 1-paragraph "what to watch" note. Does backup care require pre-approval or can I submit after booking?

omar_s: Pre-approval optional for vetted vendors, but we recommend intake before you start if possible to avoid delays. If it's urgent you can submit receipts and request retro approval.

Ryan Lopez: Quick payroll/process note: reimbursement processing takes 7-10 business days after submission. If you need faster turnaround for childcare while waiting for reimbursement, talk to @people-ops for short-term advance.

Elena Park: Great, thanks everyone. I'll file the intake form today and post confirmation here. Also tagging @Katherine to confirm her coverage slots. :)
